characters.purpose: Lock the night-radio producer's face, compact build, pinned hair, dark work coat, and right-hand product use across night and dawn.
Lock the father's weathered face, gray rain jacket, restrained warmth, and dawn-riverside silhouette across the reunion sequence.

products.purpose: Lock the Chengchuan cold-brew bottle silhouette, black cap, dark liquid, white label, readable brand text, and opened versus sealed states.

props.purpose: Lock the small rain-safe handwritten note attached to the bottle and its folded, opened, and pocketed states without changing the message.
Lock the compact red umbrella ownership, wetness, folded versus open state, and right-hand continuity through station, bus exit, and reunion.

scenes.purpose: Lock the pre-dawn radio booth, control desk, red on-air light, corridor exit, practical light sources, camera axis, and product position for S01-S06.
Lock the rain-soaked station entrance, concourse path, closing-platform sightline, bus bay, reflections, and camera fields of view for S07-S12.
Lock the late-night bus aisle, window direction, seat geography, passing-city reflections, exit door, and camera positions for S13-S14 and S16-S17.
Lock the riverside steps, railing, bench, skyline, sunrise direction, approach path, product hero surface, and camera axis for S15 and S18-S24.

shots.narrative_purpose: Establish the live pre-dawn broadcast and the deadline pressure of the on-air clock.
Reveal Lin Che's accumulated fatigue through precise fader work and a held breath rather than exposition.
Introduce the bottle and attached note as a personal invitation that competes with work urgency.
Let the father's saved voice message establish the promised sunrise without showing an explanatory flashback.
Make Lin Che choose by opening the note and bottle while the final broadcast sentence continues.
Turn the red on-air light off and launch the physical journey with product, coat, and bag states readable.
Carry momentum from the studio into hard rain while preserving right-hand umbrella and screen direction.
Show the red umbrella opening as a visual motif and practical transition into the station approach.
Use the opened bottle and departure board in one frame to make time pressure and product state coexist.
Let the train doors close before Lin Che reaches them, creating a real setback without melodrama.
Hold on her decision to continue as she notices the last night bus across the wet concourse.
Resolve the station obstacle by boarding the bus at the final moment with direction and prop states intact.
Reset rhythm inside the nearly empty bus and show the city sliding backward while she moves toward the promise.
Make the first sip a quiet emotional release synchronized with the father's voice rather than an energy claim.
Cross-cut to the father waiting without complaint, with a matching bottle and the first pale horizon behind him.
Show Lin Che sending a restrained ten-minute message as the bus reflection shifts from night toward blue hour.
Follow her through the bus exit in one continuous direction as dawn light replaces the artificial interior.
Reveal the father at the end of Lin Che's approach path before either character speaks or embraces.
Pay off the relationship through a small shared smile and a respectful pause instead of sentimental dialogue.
Bring the matching bottles together and establish that the product carried the invitation across both timelines.
Let both characters watch the sunrise in silence while the bottle silhouettes remain naturally readable.
Resolve the handwritten note beside two hands and the opened product without turning the moment into a tabletop catalog shot.
Deliver the first half of the four-second brand end frame with the bottle hero, dawn reflection, and protected title-safe area.
Hold the final brand and legal-safe composition long enough for broadcast readability and sound resolution.

appearance_states.purpose: Lock Lin Che in the dry dark studio coat, pinned hair, work bag, and right-hand product use for S01-S06.
Lock Lin Che with the same coat visibly rain-wet, red umbrella ownership, work bag, and transit continuity for S07-S17.
Lock Lin Che at dawn with rain-softened coat texture, pinned hair, bag, and tracked bottle state for S18-S24.
Lock the father in his gray rain jacket, weathered face, dawn silhouette, and matching bottle state for S15 and S18-S24.
